score_rationale: Linus has technical adaptability and relevant skills, but lacks essential hands-on hardware experience and demonstrated customer service abilities.
key_strengths: Adaptability to new technical challenges and foundational technical skills that could apply to software-related computer repairs.
key_weaknesses: Absence of direct hardware repair experience, including tasks like RAM reseating, virus clean-ups, and patience for troubleshooting older hardware and non-technical customers.
final_evaluation: Linus has some technical potential but lacks the core hands-on hardware skills and customer interaction experience required for this role. While adaptable, he needs to demonstrate more direct evidence of practical repair work and patience with customers.
